root.emit: record ${name} where { payload :: Bytes }; parse-${name} :: Bytes -> Option ${name}; parse-${name} input = case ${@decode} ${magic} ${version} input of { None -> None; Some payload -> Some (${name} { payload = payload }) }; write-${name} :: ${name} -> Option Bytes; write-${name} packet = ${@encode} ${magic} ${version} packet.payload
